new_claims.statement: For exact rank-one physical pair B=tau ell ell^T and exact rank-one pair-to-leaf cross g r^T with kernel-star scale s=|k^T g| ||r||>0, arbitrary symmetric same-leaf block D and arbitrary affine terms satisfy ||p_Q||inf <= 2^(5/2)(|tau|s)^(-1/2), with the same coefficient for interval small-ball bounds. Essential boundedness; continuity not claimed.
If additionally s3(A)>=1 and d=||D||op<1, then ||p_Q||inf <=2^(5/2)/(1-d). In particular d<=1/2 gives <11.314.
If additionally Omega_(2,H)>=1/4, either ||p_Q||inf<11.314 or |tau|<1/8, s>2 and ||D||op>7/8.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: On B=diag(1,0), g=e2, flat unit r and D=0, partner gives ||p_Q||inf<=6; new theorem extends D=t vv^T to all real t and improves the family to <=2^(9/4).
